17-0:Draft a Perfect Season

17-0: Draft a Perfect Season is a free football draft game for iPhone and the web. Spin a team and a decade, draft NFL legends from every era, play a 17-game season and try to go undefeated.

  • Three ways to draft: Classic, Full Roster and Packs, each on Easy, Medium or Hard.
  • Ring of Honor: go 17-0 in Packs and every eligible player on your roster is banked for good, a collection of pixel-art player cards.
  • Daily 17-0: one Classic draft a day on Hard, three tries, ranked by record and then the clock.
  • TD Trivia: a seven-play drive of real touchdown questions every day, with a rating that climbs as you prove your football knowledge.

Free, no ads, no in-app purchases, plays offline. Get it on the App Store or play right here in the browser.
